credits: State-space formulation suggested by Ian Holmes; helix/strand/loop probes and the repeat-extraction benchmark by Kinsey Long.
description: Phase-aware state-space unit placement: per-residue helix/strand/loop probes on ESM++ layer 35, demodulated at Talea's period into a phase vote, decoded by a hidden semi-Markov model over Talea's registered extent.

phase_vote.channel_standardization: per protein: subtract mean, divide by population SD
phase_vote.demodulation: Hann window of +/- round(P) residues, w(j) = 0.5 (1 + cos(pi j / (round(P) + 1))), local-mean-corrected; z(i) = sum_j w(j) (x(i+j) - mean) exp(-2 pi i j / P) / sum_j w(j)
phase_vote.fit: complex ridge (ridge 1e-3 x mean diagonal) on all development records' out-of-fold tracks; target exp(2 pi i phi), phi = position within the RepeatsDB unit

fit.model: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression folded into one linear map
fit.training_set: RepeatsDB class 3 development_draft.v1 residues (2,286 records); helix/strand/loop labels from experimental or predicted structures

validation.benchmark: RepeatsDB class 3 repeat extraction, test_draft.v1 (571 proteins), opened once under predeclaration_phase_ssm_v1.json (sha256 f745004b1b0c0d909a23caeb3ab7a299279bde3eea4633ea9f41531cff273bf6)
